02 / THE PERSON BEHIND THE PIXELS

More than
one thing.

a✳
ENGINEER BY LOGIC.
ARTIST BY INSTINCT.

I like making sense of complex things.
And making ordinary things interesting.

I'm a third-year Computer Science and Engineering student specializing in Generative AI at K L University, Hyderabad, with a CGPA of 9.45 / 10. My interests span full-stack web development, computer vision, and RF signal intelligence.

Since June 2026, I've been interning at the Indian Army's 509 Army Base Workshop in Agra, contributing to a counter-UAV RF detection and direction-finding project. My work includes signal analysis, direction estimation, classification, and monitoring.

My projects range from LilNest, a maternal-health web application, to MotionBeatz, a gesture-controlled music player, and a desktop RF analyzer. I'm also a co-author of NeuroCloak: Cognitive Digital Twin (CDT) for AI Systems, submitted to IEEE ICCCMLA 2026 and currently under review.

I contributed a verified merged commit to freeCodeCamp's functional-programming curriculum through PR #63872. Away from code, I make art and photographs, exploring another way to observe and tell stories. My visual diary is on Instagram at @aakash.reddie.
